name: Repulse-hand
description: The repulse-hand was a model of repulsor fist, a weaponized prosthetic, created by Control Zone Ltd. Unlike many prosthetics, the repulse-hand was not covered with the synthskin that normally gave prosthetics the appearance of a real appendage, nor was it designed with a sensory interface that would allow the user to feel through the hand as though it were real. Presentability was not a concern to the bearers of this brutish weapon.
